name: io.github.solaix/wordstat-mcp-server
title: Yandex Wordstat MCP Server
description: Unofficial Yandex Wordstat MCP server for SEO keyword research, trends, and regional interest.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WORDSTAT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Yandex Cloud API key. Set exactly one credential: this or YANDEX_WORDSTAT_IAM_TOKEN.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WORDSTAT_IAM_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Yandex Cloud IAM token. Set exactly one credential: this or YANDEX_WORDSTAT_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WORDSTAT_FOLDER_ID
environmentVariables.description: Folder ID required for user or federated-user IAM tokens.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WORDSTAT_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in milliseconds (1-300000). Server default: 30000.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WORDSTAT_MAX_RETRIES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum retries for transient failures (0-10). Server default: 2.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WORDSTAT_MAX_RPS
environmentVariables.description: Maximum requests started per second (1-10000). Server default: 8.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WORDSTAT_MAX_RPH
environmentVariables.description: Maximum logical requests per hour (0-1000000); 0 disables this limit. Server default: 100.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WORDSTAT_REGIONS_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Regions-tree cache lifetime in milliseconds (0-2592000000). Server default: 86400000.

environmentVariables.name: YANDEX_WORDSTAT_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Diagnostic log level. Server default: error.
